TcOperation.description: The return value for operation getCanonicalVariability is a runtime business object representing the configured search recipe to get canonical variability. On excuting this search recipe will return a ResultTable with six columns. The columns in the ResultTable are: container (tag_t), family namespace (string), value scope (string), family id (string), family mode (int), and value id (string).

The return value for operation getConfigurableContent is a runtime business object representing the configured search recipe to get configurable content. On excuting this search recipe will return a ResultTable with two tag_t columns, one for the container and the other for its content.

The return value for operation getImpactingVariability is a runtime business object representing the configured search recipe to get impacting variability. On excuting this search recipe will return a ResultTable with six columns. The columns in the ResultTable are: container (tag_t), family namespace (string), value scope (string), family id (string), family mode (int), and value id (string).

TcOperationAttach.description: An abstract operation is attached to WorkspaceObject with the expectation that content providers overwrite the operation on specific containers to return their respective content.
An abstract operation is attached to WorkspaceObject with the expectation that content providers overwrite the operation on specific containers to return their impacting variability.
An abstract operation is attached to WorkspaceObject with the expectation that content providers overwrite the operation on specific containers to return their canonical variability.

TcExtension.description: Business objects for which build condition functionality for canonical variability is required need to overwrite this operation with a suitable implementation of the contract. E.g. the business object type "Partition Admissibility" in the "Configurator Partition Interface" template (Cfg1) will need to overwrite the base action.
TcExtension.name: WSO__getCanonicalVariability_method

TcExtension.description: Business objects containing variant and/or effectivity configurable content for which build condition functionality is required need to overwrite this operation with a suitable implementation of the contract. E.g. the business object type "Partition" in the "Advanced PLM Services for Partitioning" template (Ptn0) will need to overwrite the base action.
TcExtension.name: WSO__getConfigurableContent_method

TcExtension.description: Business objects for which build condition functionality for impacting variability is required need to overwrite this operation with a suitable implementation of the contract. E.g. the business object type "Partitioned Admissibility" in the "Partitioned Design Guidelines" template (Pdg0) will need to overwrite the base action.
TcExtension.name: WSO__getImpactingVariability_method

TcExtensionAttach.description: Attaches extension WSO__getConfigurableContent_method to overwrite the default behavior of operation getConfigurableContent for POM objects.
Attaches extension WSO__getImpactingVariability_method to overwrite the default behavior of operation getImpactingVariability for POM objects.
Attaches extension WSO__getCanonicalVariability_method to overwrite the default behavior of operation getCanonicalVariability for POM objects.
